note: Real guest recording. F2 in the 3D viewport (mouse hovering the viewport, real HID keypress) opens Blender's generic 'Object Name' popup (wm.call_panel(name='TOPBAR_PT_name')), pre-filled and pre-selected with the current name; typing a new name and pressing Enter DOES rename the object in bpy.data.objects, but produces ZERO new entries in window_manager.operators -- verified empirically (len(operators) was 0 both immediately before AND after, across the F2 press and the confirm). The popup edits object.name directly as a UI-bound ID property, never through an operator argument.
